title: Container status
pitch: Watch a container host refresh every two seconds: who is restarting, who is near its memory limit, and what just happened.
makeItYours: Replace the samples with docker stats --no-stream --format '{{json .}}' and docker inspect for restart counts, read once per refresh.
Change the 80% and 90% memory thresholds and the CPU warning levels to fit your hosts.
Keep the dashboard running until Ctrl+C instead of four samples, and log the event feed to a file.
useCase: Use it when a container keeps restarting and you want to see memory pressure build before the next OOM kill.
